meaning: Observed static debt only; not human approval, design/WCAG compliance, rendered coverage or a CI gate.
source: Immutable tracked Git blobs; working-tree source edits and untracked files are not inspected.

ruleRegistry.meaning: Upstream registry, not a claim every rule is supported by regex.

tooling.source: Executing working-tree tooling (may differ from inspected commit)

coverage.webAndSite: Regex source checks, including HTML. No static cascade, linked resources, AST/type inference, browser or axe.
coverage.ios: All production app Swift sources; ONLY same-line Button/NavigationLink fixed-frame <44 pt regex. No native token checks.
coverage.designSystem: Web/site literal fonts, colors, radii and font sizes only when enabled and a nearest design context provides them. Package boundaries without DESIGN.md do not inherit parent rules.
unverified: Design narrative, spacing, hierarchy and human acceptance
External/generated sources and files outside the enumerated roots
coverage.suppressions: Inline and shared justified value waivers retained as suppressed observations; no hook output truncation.
coverage.disposition: Blocker is a detector classification, not a baseline gate. Either advisory:true or severity:advisory is advisory here; changed-file CI continues its existing advisory:true-only behavior.
